name: cbct-reading-windows
description: CBCT 论文每日精读助手 — Windows 版。读取项目根目录的 queue.json / papers / library / app/data，数据格式与 macOS 版一致。

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:tests && node --test dist/tests/citation.test.js dist/tests/codeMapping.test.js dist/tests/compare.test.js dist/tests/dashboard.test.js dist/tests/discovery.test.js dist/tests/e2e.test.js dist/tests/fixes.test.js dist/tests/idea.test.js dist/tests/import.test.js dist/tests/libraryWrite.test.js dist/tests/mathTypeset.test.js dist/tests/notes.test.js dist/tests/parity.test.js dist/tests/reproduction.test.js dist/tests/retrievalFigure.test.js dist/tests/result.test.js dist/tests/systemTags.test.js dist/tests/throttle.test.js dist/tests/trend.test.js
